text: リナと　いっしょに　ポケモン　そだててるんだ！

structure.jp: リナと　いっしょに
ポケモン　そだててるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. そだててる = 'am raising'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: リナと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: A person followed by と いっしょに means doing something together with that person. リナと　いっしょに = 'together with Rina'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the short spoken form of のだ and gives the feeling of telling you something about herself. そだててるんだ = 'I'm raising them, you see'.
